cohort: Female patients aged 16-45 who had pelvic fractures treated operatively
finding: Postoperative radiographic measurements did not predict delivery method after pelvic fracture fixation, and a substantial number of women with retained sacroiliac screws achieved uncomplicated vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The study compared radiographic measurements between women who had vaginal deliveries and those who had cesarean sections after pelvic fracture fixation.
